item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 13/Sep/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A dry continental airstream will bring persistently very hot and fine weather to southern China this week to early next week. Under the influence of an easterly airstream, it will be cloudier with slightly lower temperatures over the coast of southern China midweek next week. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Muifa will move across the East China Sea towards the coast of eastern China in the next couple of days. The tropical cyclone to the southwest of Iwo Jima will move in the general direction of the seas south of Japan in the next few days.
